mapper.sql: id, username, title, content, book_name, is_public, audit_status, audit_remark, create_time
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO notes (username, title, content, book_name, is_public, audit_status, audit_remark) VALUES (#{username}, #{title}, #{content}, #{bookName}, #{isPublic}, COALESCE(#{auditStatus}, 1), #{auditRemark})
mapper.select: SELECT FROM notes WHERE username = #{username} AND audit_status != 1 ORDER BY create_time DESC
SELECT FROM notes WHERE username = #{username} AND is_public = #{isPublic} AND audit_status != 1 ORDER BY create_time DESC
SELECT FROM notes WHERE username = #{username} AND audit_status = #{auditStatus} ORDER BY create_time DESC
SELECT id FROM notes WHERE username = #{username}
SELECT FROM notes WHERE audit_status = 1 ORDER BY create_time DESC
SELECT FROM notes WHERE audit_status = 2 ORDER BY create_time DESC
SELECT FROM notes WHERE username = #{username} AND is_public = 1 AND audit_status = 2 ORDER BY create_time DESC
mapper.update: UPDATE notes SET audit_status = #{auditStatus}, audit_remark = #{auditRemark} WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.select: SELECT n.id, n.username, n.title, n.content, n.book_name, n.is_public, n.audit_status, n.audit_remark, n.create_time FROM notes n INNER JOIN likes l ON l.note_id = n.id WHERE l.username = #{username} AND n.audit_status = 2 ORDER BY l.create_time DESC LIMIT #{offset}, #{limit}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM likes l INNER JOIN notes n ON l.note_id = n.id WHERE l.username = #{username} AND n.audit_status = 2
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM notes WHERE is_public = 1 AND audit_status = 2
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM notes WHERE audit_status = 1
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM notes WHERE username = #{username} AND is_public = 1 AND audit_status = 2
SELECT note_id AS noteId, COUNT(*) AS likeCount FROM likes WHERE note_id IN #{id} GROUP BY note_id
SELECT note_id AS noteId, COUNT(*) AS commentCount FROM comments WHERE note_id IN #{id} GROUP BY note_id
SELECT FROM notes WHERE id IN #{id}
